decks.notes: This aggro deck focuses on quickly getting Arclight Phoenix into the graveyard and bringing them back to the battlefield, leveraging cheap spells such as Consider and Lightning Axe to trigger their ability. The deck also includes disruptive cards such as Ashiok, Dream Render and Spell Pierce to disrupt opponent's game plan. Additionally, the deck includes card draw spells like Opt and Treasure Cruise to keep the deck running smoothly. Hall of Storm Giants provides a powerful finisher, making it difficult for opponents to come back once the deck gains momentum.

This deck focuses on utilizing Niv-Mizzet Reborn's ability to draw multiple cards and gain card advantage while controlling the board with a variety of removal spells and versatile threats. The deck also includes a companion, Yorion, Sky Nomad, to provide additional value and flexibility. The mana base is carefully crafted to ensure access to a wide range of colors, allowing for the deck to consistently cast its powerful spells. Ultimately, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver its opponent through a combination of card advantage, removal, and powerful threats.

The main focus of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to apply pressure early and consistently with low-cost creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Dusk Legion Zealot, backed up by disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The deck also leverages Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord to grant additional benefits to its vampire creatures, and utilizes cards like Archfiend of the Dross and Bitter Triumph to close out games quickly. The mana base includes lands like Mutavault and Blackcleave Cliffs to ensure a smooth curve and support the aggressive game plan.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on fast and aggressive play, using cards like Vein Ripper and Bloodtithe Harvester to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total. Thoughtseize helps disrupt the opponent's game plan, while Mutavault and Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord provide additional threats and buffs. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and impactful cards like Archfiend of the Dross for additional pressure. With a mix of creatures, disruption, and powerful finishers, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize.

The main concept of the deck is to utilize various spells and cards to quickly fill up the graveyard with instants and sorceries, allowing the player to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard multiple times in a single turn. The deck focuses on aggression and tempo, using cards like Opt, Lightning Axe, and Treasure Cruise to dig for more spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix. It also includes disruptive cards like Ashiok, Dream Render and Spell Pierce to control the opponent's game plan. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells and Phoenixes.

The Boros Aggro deck focuses on using efficient creatures and combat tricks to put pressure on the opponent quickly and efficiently. By using cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Tenth District Legionnaire alongside combat enhancers like Defiant Strike and Homestead Courage, the deck aims to win through fast and aggressive attacks. Jegantha, the Wellspring can provide additional mana acceleration and versatility, helping to further increase the deck's speed and efficiency. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of quick, powerful creatures and spells.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly applying pressure to the opponent with efficient creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Preacher of the Schism, while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord to provide additional threats and benefits. The mana base is designed to support a quick start and consistent casting of spells, with cards like Mutavault and Blackcleave Cliffs. The overall strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disrupt their plans to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the Transmogrify combo alongside various support cards to quickly bring out powerful creatures like Mirrex and Atraxa, while also disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a powerful companion option that can provide additional mana acceleration. The deck also includes a variety of dual lands and pathways to ensure consistent mana fixing, along with some utility cards like Courier's Briefcase and Boseiju, Who Endures to further support the combo strategy.

The main focus of this Mono Black Control deck is to gain advantage by disrupting the opponent's game plan with hand disruption spells like Duress and Thoughtseize, as well as removal spells like Fatal Push. The deck also aims to generate value by utilizing cards like Waste Not and Bitter Triumph, while maintaining control through powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. Additionally, the deck includes graveyard hate with cards like Cling to Dust and utilizes lands like Field of Ruin and Geier Reach Sanitarium for additional disruption and card advantage.

This deck focuses on quickly building up a board presence with low-cost creatures and utilizing combat tricks and burn spells to push through damage and overwhelm the opponent. By taking advantage of the synergy between creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Tenth District Legionnaire, as well as spells like Defiant Strike and Monstrous Rage, the deck aims to consistently pressure the opponent and finish them off before they can stabilize. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a powerful companion option that can provide additional mana ramp in the late game.

The inclusion of Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord and Archfiend of the Dross provides additional value and closing power to seal the game in its favor. This deck aims to win quickly by overwhelming the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and removal spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of creatures and spells to generate life and create a powerful board presence. Cards like Amalia Benavides Aguirre, Wildgrowth Walker, and Prosperous Innkeeper help gain life while Fauna Shaman, Chord of Calling, and Collected Company provide access to key combo pieces. Return to the Ranks and Aetherflux Reservoir can help finish off opponents with a burst of damage. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a mix of life gain, creature synergies, and combo potential to secure victory.
